text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seven panels, each mesh on a welded frame of 25 x 25 x 3 angle:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sides 635 (right) and 675 (left) x 1,391 mm; rear 940 x 1,391;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: front strips 180 x 1,391; lower front 580 x 320; roof 940 x 675

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a cut-out round the top beam. Mesh drawn at every 8th wire.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pump slot (right side): 30 x 220 mm, 200 to 420 mm up, centred 218 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in front of the middle; frame it with 3 mm strip and a brush strip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Interlock holes (front right strip): 44 mm square at the release

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft and a 40 mm square for the pin cable.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fixing mesh: clamp it under bolted flat strips, or grind the zinc

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: off before welding (fume: see safety stops).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Standoffs: eight 40 x 6 mm flat bars bolted to the beam webs; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side panels bolt to them. Panels bolt to each other with M8.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Right front strip sits 40 mm back to leave a pocket for the interlock.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: flat within 3 mm; no panel over about 10 kg.
